channel.title: Kettlebell Movement a Day
channel.description: One kettlebell movement a day with a short coaching cue.

item.title: Clean
item.description:
Pull the bell up close and let it rotate softly into the rack position.

Category: ballistic  |  Level: intermediate

item.title: Alternating Swing
item.description:
Switch hands at the top of the swing without breaking your rhythm.

Category: ballistic  |  Level: intermediate

item.title: Single-Arm Swing
item.description:
Swing the bell between your legs, then snap your hips to send it forward.

Category: ballistic  |  Level: intermediate

item.title: Sit-Up to Press
item.description:
Sit up holding the bell at your chest, then press it overhead at the top.

Category: core  |  Level: intermediate

item.title: Windmill
item.description:
Press the bell overhead, then hinge sideways while keeping your eyes on it.

Category: core  |  Level: advanced

item.title: Halo
item.description:
Circle the bell around your head, keeping your core tight and ribs down.

Category: core  |  Level: beginner

item.title: Plank Pull-Through
item.description:
In a plank, drag the bell under your body from side to side.

Category: core  |  Level: intermediate

item.title: Russian Twist
item.description:
Sit back slightly and rotate the bell side to side under control.

Category: core  |  Level: beginner

item.title: Waiter's Walk
item.description:
Balance the bell overhead on an open palm and walk slowly and controlled.

Category: carry  |  Level: advanced

item.title: Overhead Carry
item.description:
Lock the bell out overhead and walk while keeping your ribs pulled down.

Category: carry  |  Level: intermediate

item.title: Rack Carry
item.description:
Hold the bell at your shoulder and walk without letting it drift outward.

Category: carry  |  Level: intermediate

item.title: Suitcase Carry
item.description:
Carry one bell at your side and resist leaning toward it.

Category: carry  |  Level: beginner

item.title: Farmer's Carry
item.description:
Hold a bell in each hand and walk tall with your shoulders back.

Category: carry  |  Level: beginner

item.title: Upright Row
item.description:
Pull the bell up close to your body to about chest height.

Category: pull  |  Level: beginner

item.title: Single-Arm Row
item.description:
Brace on a bench and pull the bell straight up to your ribs.

Category: pull  |  Level: beginner

item.title: High Pull
item.description:
Pull the bell up close to your body, leading with your elbow.

Category: pull  |  Level: intermediate

item.title: Renegade Row
item.description:
Hold a plank on the bells and row one up without twisting your hips.

Category: pull  |  Level: advanced

item.title: Bent-Over Row
item.description:
Hinge forward with a flat back and pull the bell to your hip.

Category: pull  |  Level: beginner

item.title: Thruster
item.description:
Squat down, then use the upward drive to press the bell overhead.

Category: press  |  Level: intermediate

item.title: Half-Kneeling Press
item.description:
Kneel on one knee and press the bell up without arching your lower back.

Category: press  |  Level: intermediate

item.title: Bottoms-Up Press
item.description:
Grip the handle tight and press slowly to keep the bell from tipping.

Category: press  |  Level: advanced

item.title: Push Press
item.description:
Dip slightly at the knees, then drive up and press the bell overhead.

Category: press  |  Level: intermediate

item.title: Strict Press
item.description:
Brace your core and press straight up without leaning back.

Category: press  |  Level: beginner

item.title: Squat to Press
item.description:
Stand up out of the squat and press the bell overhead in one smooth motion.

Category: squat  |  Level: intermediate

item.title: Cossack Squat
item.description:
Shift your weight to one side and sit back while keeping the other leg straight.

Category: squat  |  Level: intermediate

item.title: Sumo Squat
item.description:
Take a wide stance and push your knees out as you sit down.

Category: squat  |  Level: beginner

item.title: Front Squat
item.description:
Rack the bells at your shoulders and keep your chest tall through the squat.

Category: squat  |  Level: intermediate

item.title: Goblet Squat
item.description:
Hold the bell at your chest and sit down between your knees, elbows inside.

Category: squat  |  Level: beginner

item.title: Two-Hand Swing
item.description:
Hike the bell back like a football snap, then snap your hips forward hard.

Category: hinge  |  Level: beginner

item.title: Good Morning
item.description:
Keep a soft bend in the knees and hinge forward with a flat back.

Category: hinge  |  Level: intermediate
